title: OwnMem promotion decision
description: How far one proposed change may travel without a person, and why it stopped there. Like the candidate schema, this is a gate at the exit rather than a promise each producer keeps: the shape has to hold for producers that do not exist yet -- a host adapter, a model-backed proposer -- and the invariants below therefore do not depend on the policy module being correct. Two of them are the whole point: a high-risk decision cannot be encoded as automatic at all, and an automatic decision cannot carry a blocker.

risk.description: Blast radius if this turns out to be wrong. It grades the change, never how often the change has worked.

logical_type.description: What kind of memory this is about, or null when the request is not about writing one.

current_lifecycle.description: Where it is now. Null is a first import, which the lifecycle graph admits from nowhere.

target_lifecycle.description: Where the request wanted to go. Echoed rather than clamped to the ceiling: a decision that quietly rewrote what was asked for would be unreadable as a receipt.

ceiling.description: The furthest lifecycle this request could have reached with nobody watching, or null when nothing could. Only promotion states appear here; a demotion is never something a ceiling permits.

automation.description: auto: the system may apply it. review: a person may approve it, and nothing happens until they do. pr-only: the system may produce reviewable material and nothing else. forbidden: the system may not act at all.

reasons.description: Why it landed here, in sentences. Required and non-empty because the readable half is the deliverable: someone should be able to see why a promotion was not automatic without opening the policy module.

blocked_by.description: Machine-readable codes for everything that stopped automation, one per cause. Empty exactly when the decision is automatic.

statistics.description: The observation record this decision was graded against, or null when none applied. Carried on the decision so the numbers travel with the verdict.

allOf.description: R4 and R5 can never be encoded as automatic, whatever the evidence or the repository configuration says. Written here as well as in the policy so that a producer building a decision by hand is bound by it too.
The control plane -- policy, gates, permissions, this system's own code -- may not take effect from inside at all, so R5 is not merely non-automatic.
An automatic decision that also names a blocker is self-contradictory, and it is the exact shape a bug in the resolver would produce.

statistics.description: What the observation record supports. There is deliberately no field here naming how likely the thing is to hold: the bound is a floor under an unbroken run, and the vocabulary of this object is not allowed to suggest otherwise.

verdict.description: circuit_broken: at least one independent episode failed, whatever the bound says. insufficient_evidence: too few episodes, or a bound that does not clear the weak gate. weak_pass: no failure seen and the bound clears -- which means 'not seen to fail and not obviously bad', and nothing more.

independent_episodes.description: Distinct turns. Repeats inside one turn are one data point, because eight triggers of the same procedure in one turn are one situation.

independent_sessions.description: Reported, never gated on. Twelve episodes in one session are weaker than twelve across twelve days, and a reader should see that; no measurement here says how much weaker.

observations_collapsed.description: Observations that shared a turn with an earlier one and so added no data point. Reported so the collapsing is visible rather than quiet.

observations_unattributable.description: Observations with no turn identity at all. They cannot be shown to be independent, so they are excluded and counted here rather than folded in.

lower_bound.description: One-sided 95% Wilson lower bound over independent episodes, or null when there are none. Named for what it is: a bound, not a rate and not a claim.

interpretation.description: Pinned. The bound exists to run a weak gate and a circuit breaker, and this field is what stops a later reader from quoting it as anything stronger.
